dup_elf calls next_arhdr to read the first member header.\"}, {\"step\": 4, \"file\": \"libelf/elf_begin.c\", \"function\": \"__libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock\", \"line\": 913, \"var\": \"elf->state.ar.long_names\", \"code\": \"read_long_names(elf)\", \"note\": \"The first archive member has ar_name starting with / followed by digits (a long name reference), so read_long_names is invoked to locate the // long-names table.\"}, {\"step\": 5, \"file\": \"libelf/elf_begin.c\", \"function\": \"read_long_names\", \"line\": 765, \"var\": \"len\", \"code\": \"len = atol(string)\", \"note\": \"atol is called on the ar_size field without verifying it starts with a digit; a malformed ar_size yields an unexpected value (e.g. negative or 0).\"}, {\"step\": 6, \"file\": \"libelf/elf_begin.c\", \"function\": \"read_long_names\", \"line\": 771, \"var\": \"offset\", \"code\": \"offset += sizeof(struct ar_hdr) + ((len + 1) & ~1l)\", \"note\": \"A negative len from atol causes the offset arithmetic to wrap, making the scan read archive headers from unexpected in-file locations.\"}, {\"step\": 7, \"file\": \"libelf/elf_begin.c\", \"function\": \"read_long_names\", \"line\": 790, \"var\": \"newp\", \"code\": \"newp = malloc(len)\", \"note\": \"When a // entry is found with a malformed ar_size, malloc is called with a huge size_t (negative len converted to unsigned), and if it succeeds the subsequent memcpy reads out of bounds from the mapped file, causing the ASAN crash.\"}]"}
